'''Peter Bruce Andrews''' (November 1, 1937 – April 21, 2025)<ref>{{citation |url=https://www.lowefuneralhome.com/obituaries/peter-andrews |title=Peter Bruce Andrews Obituary|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250606052151/https://www.lowefuneralhome.com/obituaries/peter-andrews |archive-date=2025-06-06 |access-date=2025-06-06 | url-status=live }}</ref> was an American mathematical logician. He is the creator of the [[Q0 (mathematical logic)|mathematical logic Q<sub>0</sub>]]. He also received a patent for a bandage system that allows access to wounds without the need to remove the bandage completely.<ref>{{cite patent

==Theorem Proving System==

His research group designed the TPS,<ref>{{citation |url=https://gtps.math.cmu.edu/tps.html |title=TPS and ETPS |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220327070123/https://gtps.math.cmu.edu/tps.html |archive-date=2022-03-27 |access-date=2025-06-06 }}</ref> an [[automated theorem proving]] system for [[First-order logic|first-order]] and [[higher-order logic]]. A subsystem ETPS of TPS is used to help students learn logic by interactively constructing [[natural deduction]] proofs.  Source code of TPS is available on the [[Internet Archive]].<ref>{{citation |url=https://archive.org/details/theorem_proving_system_peter_bruce_andrews.tar |title=TPS source code|access-date=2025-06-06 }}</ref>

==Selected publications==
A list is available on his personal web page.<ref>{{citation |url=http://gtps.math.cmu.edu/andrews.html |title=Peter B. Andrews |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220119160142/https://gtps.math.cmu.edu/andrews.html |archive-date=2022-01-19 |access-date=2025-06-06 }}</ref>

*Andrews, Peter B. (1965). ''A Transfinite Type Theory with Type Variables''. North Holland Publishing Company, Amsterdam.
*Andrews, Peter B. (1971). "Resolution in type theory". ''[[Journal of Symbolic Logic]]'' '''36''', 414–432.
*Andrews, Peter B. (1981). "Theorem proving via general matings". ''[[Journal of the ACM|J. Assoc. Comput.]]'' March. '''28''', no. 2, 193–214.
*Andrews, Peter B. (1986). ''An introduction to mathematical logic and type theory: to truth through proof''. Computer Science and Applied Mathematics. {{ISBN|978-0-1205-8535-9}}. Academic Press, Inc., Orlando, FL.
*Andrews, Peter B. (1989). "On connections and higher-order logic". ''[[Journal of Automated Reasoning|J. Automat. Reason.]]'' '''5''', no. 3, 257–291.
*Andrews, Peter B.; Bishop, Matthew; Issar, Sunil; Nesmith, Dan; [[Frank Pfenning|Pfenning, Frank]]; Xi, Hongwei (1996). "TPS: a theorem-proving system for classical type theory". ''[[Journal of Automated Reasoning|J. Automat. Reason.]]'' '''16''', no. 3, 321–353.
*Andrews, Peter B. (2002). ''An introduction to mathematical logic and type theory: to truth through proof''. Second edition. Applied Logic Series, 27. {{ISBN|978-1-4020-0763-7}}. Kluwer Academic Publishers, Dordrecht.
